text:
ellie-ops: Heads up — EU H100 shipment for PO `4721` is due into FRA tomorrow morning. We need 8 units rerouted to AMS depot for immediate cluster spin-up. Can you confirm a split and any customs implications?

matt-procurement: What's the delta on lead time and cost if we do the split?

jin-vendor: We can split the shipment but reconsignment requires AWB amendment + customs paperwork. Typical uplift is €420 per pallet for the reconsignment handling. Estimated ETA to AMS is +24h after FRA arrival. Need a PO amendment to proceed.

ellie-ops: OK on the fee if it keeps clusters healthy. Also — if any DOA units show up, what's the RMA/advance-replacement flow?

sara-logistics: RMA flow (short): depot inspects -> opens RMA -> vendor pre-authorizes advance replacement from EU spare pool -> advance ships within 48h. Customs release can add ~1 business day depending on manifest. We need photos + short hardware log for DOA.

jin-vendor: Confirmed: EU spare pool currently has 12 units available. For RMA advance ship we'll pre-authorize against serials. Procedure: send photo of failure, serial, short log (output error / POST codes).

ellie-ops: Serial range for the 8 to divert: `H100-EB-8421` through `H100-EB-8428`. I'll drop full list in #ops-serials. Please create PO amendment for split: 8 -> AMS, remainder -> FRA.

rma-bot: RMA ticket created: `RMA-2024-3319`. Return label generation queued, status: pending label.

matt-procurement: I approve the €420 reconsignment fee. Please add a line item on the invoice: `reconsignment fee (PO 4721) €420 x 1`. Vendor: confirm insurance for in-transit damage (declared value).

jin-vendor: We can insure at declared value. Sending AWB and amendment in ~20m. Provisional AWB: `1Z999FAW12345`. Will attach amendment PDF. Invoice will include `reconsignment fee` line.

sara-logistics: Note — AMS depot currently has 10 racking slots free. If units arrive before we finish staging, we can temporary-stage up to 5 pallets. Otherwise prefer crossdock -> direct install to avoid staging costs.

ellie-ops: We can pre-schedule installs. @sara-logistics please tentatively book install window 02/15 09:00 CET for 8 units; fallback 02/15 15:00 CET if AWB shifts.

sara-logistics: Tentative slot booked: 02/15 09:00 CET. If AWB delayed I'll move to 15:00 slot, will confirm ASAP.

jin-vendor: Amendment and AWB sent to your procurement email. AWB updated to `1Z999FAW12345` -> route FRA->AMS. Invoice draft attached. Please confirm PO signature to finalize.

ellie-ops: Signed amendment uploaded: `drive.redwood/internal/po/4721_amend_signed.pdf`. Uploaded at 11:22 CET.

rma-bot: Return label generated: https://carrier.example/label/RMA-2024-3319.pdf (expires in 14 days).

matt-procurement: Good. Low risk on our side. Vendor — confirm once label is picked up and if customs flags the shipment.

jin-vendor: Will monitor and update in this thread. If customs holds, we will escalate to our EU customs broker and aim for same-day release.

ellie-ops: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist: 1) PO amendment signed (done) 2) AWB + invoice reflect reconsignment fee (vendor) 3) AMS install slot tentatively booked (sara) 4) RMA pre-auth + spare pool confirmed (jin) — let's keep this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
